source_evidence: Frozen tests/test.sh:212-225 runs the gates suite before the scored suite against the same launched app process; it does not reseed between them.
Frozen tests/gates/render/prompt.md:17 and tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23,27 permit an empty library and forbid changing durable records; ordering with Constraints is therefore harmless.
Frozen tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29 creates a unique gate record without altering existing records, leaves it saved, and forbids an exact library count.

Frozen tests/app_context.md:24 tells all judges the gate record remains, browser identities are not shared, Functional uses distinct fixtures, no judge assumes an empty library, Polish may create one dedicated harmless record, and Visual makes no saved-record mutation.

Frozen tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:5,19,107,430-434 uses current observed library identities, fields and revisions, leaves gate/unknown records alone, and compares the actual collection across one restart without fixed count or order.
Frozen tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:19-26,34,45-49 accepts the current library, creates its own control record for the keyboard route, and preserves existing records.
Frozen tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:31-43,52-57 accepts current and empty library/console states, makes no save demand, and says earlier database mutations are not visual defects.

The frozen staged template tests/test.sh has the same gates-then-scored suite handoff, and its scoring.toml retains the three scored dimensions. The task-specific prompt changes are the relevant state contract.

adversarial_checks.candidate: Broken app treats title as unique and overwrites the first saved record when a second with the same title is created.
adversarial_checks.result: Does not escape this rubric: Functional S21 requires separate identities and exact readbacks; S22 records and compares the actual whole collection.

adversarial_checks.candidate: Broken app clears gate and earlier functional records on process restart while presenting a usable empty library.
adversarial_checks.result: Functional S22 records current records and history before restart, then compares every actual identity/field/revision after restart; this is a product failure, not a pristine-seed assumption.

adversarial_checks.candidate: Conforming app begins the scored suite with a gate-created record, uses arbitrary record IDs, allows duplicate display titles, and may have an empty console.
adversarial_checks.result: Accepted by the prompt contract: unique gate title only for creation, state-relative record/revision checks, no exact library count/order, and Visual accepts empty console.
